Title: Ebb and Flow Hydroponics: Flood Timing, Media & Setup
Description: Ebb and flow floods a media tray to 1 in below the top for 10–30 minutes, then drains it. Start once a day; keep pH near 6.0 and EC 1.2–1.8 for greens. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: ebb and flow hydroponics, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
